summary: A static website for Corner Cafe with a menu page listing dishes grouped into starters, mains, and desserts, each with a name, a euro price with two decimals, and a vegetarian mark, plus an about page showing the opening hours.
targetUsers: Cafe visitors checking the menu before or during a visit
People looking up Corner Cafe's opening hours
goals: Show every dish grouped under starters, mains, and desserts with name, euro price to two decimals, and vegetarian mark
Show the cafe's opening hours on an about page
nonGoals: User accounts or any visitor-submitted content

features.name: Menu page
features.userOutcome: Visitor sees all dishes grouped into starters, mains, and desserts, each with its name, euro price with two decimals, and vegetarian mark.
features.behavior: The page renders three groups in fixed order: starters, mains, desserts. Within each group dishes are listed in the order stored. Each dish shows its name, its price formatted in euros with exactly two decimals (for example 6.50 €), and a vegetarian mark shown only when the dish's vegetarian flag is true. Dishes whose group is starters appear only under starters, and likewise for mains and desserts.
features.failureOutcome: The build fails when a dish content file is missing its name, price, group, or vegetarian flag, or names a group other than starters, mains, or desserts.
acceptanceSignals: The built menu page contains a starters section, a mains section, and a desserts section in that order.
Every dish on the built menu page shows a price rendered with exactly two decimal places and a euro sign.
A dish whose vegetarian flag is true shows the vegetarian mark; a dish whose flag is false does not.
No dish appears under a group other than the one stored for it.

features.name: About page with opening hours
features.userOutcome: Visitor sees the cafe's opening hours on the about page.
features.behavior: The about page renders the stored opening hours as a list of day-and-hours entries in the stored order, each showing the day and its hours exactly as stored.
features.failureOutcome: The build fails when an opening hours content file is missing its day or its hours.
acceptanceSignals: The built about page exists and lists every stored opening hours entry with its day and hours text.
The opening hours entries appear on the about page in the stored order.

dataObjects.name: Dishes
dataObjects.purpose: Menu dishes shown on the menu page, each with a name, euro price, vegetarian mark, and group.
dataObjects.retentionIntent: Kept as site content for as long as the menu page is published.

dataObjects.name: Opening hours
dataObjects.purpose: Day-and-hours entries shown on the about page.
dataObjects.retentionIntent: Kept as site content for as long as the about page is published.

qualityRequirements: Prices are rendered in euros with exactly two decimal places on every dish.
The menu page groups dishes under starters, mains, and desserts in that fixed order.
productConstraints: The site is static: pages are built once from content files.
The menu page is the home page; the about page is a separate page.
